Switch to “{{label}}”?

bigram.label: Lightweight (bigram)
bigram.description: Virtually no download or compute cost. Finds notes with similar wording.

mpnet.label: High-accuracy (multilingual)
mpnet.description: Downloads a ~280MB model on first use. Finds notes with similar meaning, even across languages.

login.heroLead: ZettelNote is a Zettelkasten-style note app that surfaces related notes in real time as you write. Not a filing system — a way to discover connections.
login.feature3: Zero-knowledge encryption — we can't read your notes
login.feature4: Automatic sync across desktop and web
login.webNotice: The web app requires a server login (it's an always-synced thin client).
login.backToLocalMode: ← Try it without logging in (local mode)
